headword: {目頭|めがしら}が{熱|あつ}くなる
reading: めがしらがあつくなる
gloss: to be moved to tears; to feel tears welling up

definitions.gloss: to be moved to tears; to feel tears welling up
definitions.explanation: Literally 'the inner corners of one's eyes become hot.' Describes the physical sensation of being on the verge of tears due to being deeply moved, touched, or emotionally stirred. More restrained than actually crying.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧{目頭|めがしら}が{熱|あつ}くなった。
examples.english: I was moved to tears hearing that story.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧たち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歌|うた}→歌：02179_uta⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧{目頭|めがしら}が{熱|あつ}くなった。
examples.english: I felt tears welling up when I heard the students sing at the graduation ceremony.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{離|はな}れていた→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧⟦{親子|おやこ}→親子：10430_oyako⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{再会|さいかい}→再会：11667_saikai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{場面|ばめん}→場面：03702_bamen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{思|おも}わ→思う：00492_omou⟧ず{目頭|めがしら}が{熱|あつ}くなる。
examples.english: In scenes where a parent and child who have been apart for years are reunited, you can't help but feel tears welling up.

notes:
USAGE:
This expression describes the moment just before tears come — the physical warmth felt at the inner corners of the eyes. It conveys being deeply moved without necessarily crying. Often used with ⟦{思|おも}わ→思う：00492_omou⟧ず (involuntarily) to emphasize the spontaneous nature of the emotion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{思|おも}わ→思う：00492_omou⟧ず{目頭|めがしら}が{熱|あつ}くなる (to involuntarily feel tears welling up)
- {目頭|めがしら}が{熱|あつ}くなる⟦{場面|ばめん}→場面：03702_bamen⟧ (a scene that moves one to tears)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: tears actually fall — describes the result rather than the onset
- ⟦{胸|むね}が{熱|あつ}くなる→胸が熱くなる：20455_munegaatsukunaru⟧: one's heart is moved — focuses on emotion in the chest rather than eyes
